newsitem.title: HUNGARY: GLOBUS RALLIES 52-WK HIGH ON TIGHT SUPPLY.
newsitem.headline: GLOBUS RALLIES 52-WK HIGH ON TIGHT SUPPLY.

text.p: A more than 16 percent jump in shares of Hungarian tinned food manufacturer Globus Konzervipari Rt to a new 52-week high of 2,450 forints on Monday caught many traders surprised.
Three contacted traders knew about no fresh information about the company, but one of them said tight supply contributed to its surge.
"There isn't any fresh information about Globus, but its liquidity is thin, therefore increasing demand drives it prices easily up," one trader said. "Globus's turnover is surprising."
At 1109 GMT Globus stood at 2,400 forints, up 300, with almost 32,000 units changing hands until this time.
